articles.summary: Leading producer, distributor and marketer of fresh and shelf-stable food products steps forward with local community to help advance the fight against diabetes, October 11 Del Monte Corporation , one of the world's leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable produce, today announced its sponsorship of the American Diabetes Association's (ADA) annual Step Out® Walk in Pittsburgh on September 26 at PNC Park, joining community members, advocates, healthcare professionals and families in the fight to prevent and cure diabetes while improving the lives of everyone affected by the disease. The partnership reflects Del Monte's continued commitment to strengthening its presence in the Steel City—a community where its North American Foods Division has called home for more than two decades. “We believe in investing in the health and well-being of the communities we serve, and it’s especially meaningful to engage in the local Pittsburgh
articles.title: Del Monte Proudly Announces Sponsorship of American Diabetes Association's Step Out Walk in Pittsburgh

articles.summary: New joint venture combines Del Monte's brand strength and fresh-cut expertise with Riverking's local sourcing and distribution network to serve China's fast-growing fresh-cut fruit market Del Monte Corporation (NYSE: DMC), one of the world's leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable produce, today announced that its subsidiary, Del Monte Fresh Produce (HK) Ltd., has entered into a joint venture with Riverking (Shanghai) Agricultural Technology Development Co., Ltd., a leading integrated private fruit enterprise, to expand into the fresh-cut fruit segment in China. The joint venture combines Del Monte's brand strength, differentiated packaging, and fresh-cut experience and technology with Riverking's local sourcing, distribution, and customer networks, positioning the partnership to establish a strong presence in China's rapidly growing fresh-cut fruit market. articles.title: Del Monte Corporation and Riverking Group Announce Joint Venture to Expand Fresh-Cut Fruit Business in China
